notes.title: Orb Tower now available on Android!
notes.content:
[h1]Orbs in your pocket[/h1]
 Hi all !

I just released Orb Tower on the google play store for Android, you can find it here :
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.VandermaesenGames.OrbTower

It has all the features and content of the original version, with the extra spice of being available anywhere you go!

Enjoy :)

Pierre

notes.title: Post Launch Hotfixes and tweaks
notes.content:
Hi all !

I just released a small update for the game, including some bug fixes and difficulty tweaks :

[list]
[*] Fixed the steam achievements not unlocking
[*] Nerfed bombs (their explosion radius has been decreased)
[*] Nerfed the needle item (alone orbs now have a 50% chance of being popped)
[*] Nerfed the Jester boss (orbs now only move every 3 turns instead of every turn)
[*] Made runes cheaper
[*] Fixed some small typos / text errors
[*] Fixed the boomerang effect triggering a boss ability
[*] Fixed soflocks when boss ability destroys/changes the last available orb
[*] Fixed settings menu overlapping the win screen
[/list]

On another note, I added some simple support for the Steamdeck regarding the joystick and screen resolution, but since I'm not able to test it (I don't have a steamdeck), please feel free to reach out and share your opinion on the game feel !

Thank you so much for getting the game so early ! There might still be little quirks, but I'm very happy to see people are envoying the game nonetheless !

Peace ❤️
Pierre
